player_policy: validate explicit player choice with same physical constraints
do not replace an invalid player choice with a different automatic activity
rules: Interest/hobby affinity raises likelihood but does not guarantee selection.
No affinity match may still yield a neutral feasible activity when authored policy permits.
Species, gender, culture, branch, social rank and player proximity are not generic leisure-choice weights.
Raw personality labels are not deterministic activity mappings; only explicit preference state may contribute.
NPC plans are stable for the same authoritative inputs and rules version.
Observation/materialization cannot reroll a persisted plan.
No Step-6 selection directly mutates relationships, wellbeing, habits, grades or discipline.
